decisions.reason: The DCDC1 requirement already excludes the LEDs from its listed 3.3V loads, and the source does not change its voltage, rating, or normal-operation role.
This candidate already has a complete message-284 MODIFY recording 5V power from the power board and the required data level shifter.
The switchable 5V rail already includes the SK6812 LEDs as powered loads; the source does not change its converter, enable control, load set, or standby policy.
Changing which rail powers the LEDs does not alter native USB data routing, enumeration, flashing, or connector sourceability.
The LEDs remain powered through circuitry on the power board, so the AXP2101 normal-operation power-path requirement remains valid unchanged.
The source changes the LEDs' power and logic interface, not the daughterboard's LED count, board form, addressability, or selected part.
The LED supply and level-shifter decision does not change any I2C pull-up, speed, cable-length, or series-resistor requirement.
The source requires logic-level shifting but does not select or change an ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment.
The 5V LED supply and level-shifter decision does not change the selected ESP32-S3 controller family.
The existing interboard interface already provides a 5V power connection; the source does not change connector selection, partitioning, pinout, or pin-order policy.
The source concerns LED power and logic levels and does not change the sensor board's connector-fanout role.
The source does not change any BOM completeness, sourcing, population, or component-justification requirement.
